paragraphs.text: By the boon hand, glory-giving gets enacted, and the principle stays fixed and unstained. Fearlessness uproots the world-fears, and grace sits palmed and ready. Shattered MAyA-skull, borne while waking is shown. Essence wholly taken, rest in the mass: by skull-staff-bone pretext, the command goes out.

Lute, bell, drum — wild One, playing: this You show, and triple-split work-sound is heard by one standing. ParA-led triple-spoked power, lovely and great: gods You mirror outside, trident held always. Will-led powers shown in lower seats three; Your own supreme power, thunder-made, borne six-spoked. World entire by Your power tamed, all stations held: staff-revealed, Consciousness-Bhairava, to us.

Mace and axe borne, bindu-sound mirrored; bent on splitting split from unsplit, You point, O ISAna. By differing visions, Lord, shapes assumed and shed: waking-made Bhairava proclaimed, own abode everywhere.
